selectiveAotExperiment.limitation: One selective AOT attempt, not complete AOT or all possible AOT settings; larger payload without improvement on tested scenes.

validation.selectedLongScenario: large-map food webs survive long revisit intervals and deterministic resume

limitations: Native timings exclude generation, warmup, serialization, UI and browser execution; not WebAssembly timings.
Three native repetitions and short browser observations are not statistical confidence or a long-run guarantee.
Full view is 1440x960; near view is 390x844 touch emulation, not a physical phone.
Pressure fixture is flat grass with generated water and plants retained, not a default natural map.
Instrumentation adds overhead; parent and child totals overlap. Historical browser probe windows advance different simulated days at different throughput, so phase comparisons are descriptive.
Terrain hash scanning increased in this probe, while terrain drawing and whole-map refresh decreased.
Fast-mode soft slice is 48 ms, normal mode is 12 ms; a first atomic step can exceed the slice, and fast-mode frame gaps increased.
Tested 2000-resident scenes still fall below 25 days/s. Core single-step elapsed time alone remains about 65-67 ms.
Full 256x256 terrain reuse retains about 16 MiB extra RGBA memory and 289 KiB tile inputs.
Autosave still pauses simulation during snapshot capture; no save format or snapshot semantics were changed.
Optimized build is local and uncommitted; no public deployment was performed.
